name: MLPerf Inference v4.1 NVIDIA H200-SXM-141GBx8_TRT_MaxQ mixtral-8x7b Offline run_1 power trace
notes: RAW 1 Hz power trace, same instrument and format, for a MoE workload (mixtral-8x7b) on the SAME 8xH200 MaxQ node as the llama2-70b traces. 2980 samples. This pairing is the most useful thing in the set for cost work: identical hardware, identical power envelope, identical instrument, two different models, so the joules/token difference is attributable to the model and not to the platform.
